> "More than fortune and fame, the dream in the heart of most scientists is autonomy."

So true! I also really like david langs vision of lots and lots of little research institutes and experiments. That reminds me of the bureaus (plural!) of municipal research setup a century ago that were instrumental in the development in the modern administrative state. So much of the current discussion of state capacity is in the abstract although the path to actual improvement (rather than high modernist reform larping) lies through local knowledge and insight. It also strikes me there is lots of opportunity for lower cost, high quality applied social science type of research by cutting out the middleman and administrative bloat. 

Let zillions of experiments bloom!
